'''''Jungle Ghost''''' was an [[Ithorian Herdship]].

==Characteristics==
''Jungle Ghost'' was similar to almost every other [[Ithorian Herdship]], being a huge flattened ball which was designed to simulate the jungles of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] homeworld, in a space-worthy vessel.

==History==
''Jungle Ghost'' visited the systems along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. It would often disappear into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] for months at a time and then return with a variety of fascinating and rare trade goods.
